definitions.short: Kelub , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H3620. Kelub כְּלוּב proper name, masculine 1. a name in Judah 1Chr 4:11 , ᵐ5 Ξαλεβ (according to We Gentib. 20, Hist. 218 = חֶזְרוֺן בֶּןֿ כָּלֵב ; read also for כַּרְמִי 4:1 ). 2 father of one of David's officers , according to 1Chr 27:26 ( ᵐ5 Ξοβουδ , A Ξαλουβ , ᵐ5 L Ξαλουβ ).
